summary: Microburst billing spike after async postback replay caused provisional charge on dedicated account
description: Issue summary: Customer reports a sharp provisional billing spike (hourly line item) that coincided with an automated postback replayer job. Impact: CleverDocs saw a ~12x hourly usage spike billed to their dedicated account resulting in a provisional invoice hold and alerting their finance team; customer-facing services were unaffected. Environment: dedicated cluster (us-east-1), prod. Steps to reproduce: 1) Replayer job started at 2026-03-09T22:05:00Z to backfill delayed postbacks. 2) Replayer concurrently pushed N postbacks to billing ingestion. 3) Hourly accumulator created a provisional hourly line for customer that reflects the burst. 4) Reconciler later deduplicated some events but provisional charge remained in UI and invoice preview. Logs and key traces are attached below (log excerpts in investigation_notes). Requested outcome: remove provisional overcharge from invoice preview, confirm no live bill will be charged, and update reconciler to prevent similar microbursts hitting hourly accumulator.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger postback replayer with large window (e.g., 6h backlog) against prod postback topic. 2) Observe spike in billing-ingest QPS and corresponding hourly accumulator creation for affected org IDs. 3) Wait for dedupe pass; check invoice preview and provisional lines in Console > Billing > Hourly. Expected: dedupe should prevent double-counting and avoid provisional spikes. Actual: provisional hourly line persisted until manual reconciliation.

comments: Support (2026-03-10) - Sofia Martinez: Acknowledged. Opening investigation with billing and SRE. Informed customer we will prioritize and that provisional charge is under review.

Customer (2026-03-10) - Priya Shah (CleverDocs): We received an automated invoice preview showing a large hourly line and our accounting flagged it. Please confirm whether our credit card will be charged while this is provisional.

SRE (2026-03-11) - Arun Gupta: Replayer job was restarted due to offset tombstone; it replayed 420 batches concurrently. Billing-ingest handled the load but hourly-accumulator created a provisional line before dedupe completed. Dedupe reduced recorded tokens by ~99.7% for this window.

Billing Eng (2026-03-12) - Mei Lin: The accumulator marks provisional immediately on first write. A later reconciler pass applies corrections, but UI was not refreshing invoice preview for provisional removals. Raised PR to surface reconciler adjustments to UI (see linked PR).

Support (2026-03-13) - Sofia Martinez: Sent customer an interim note: No live charge will be applied while we hold provisional lines under review. Shared manual waiver path if they need formal credit applied immediately.
Customer (2026-03-13) - Priya Shah (CleverDocs): Thanks. Please confirm when the provisional line is removed so we can close our internal ticket.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Postback replayer concurrency + lack of ingest-side rate-limiting allowed a microburst to create a provisional hourly accumulator entry before dedupe. Observations: 1) Reconciler successfully deduped ~99.7% of events but reconciler-to-console propagation lagged (~3 minutes) and invoice preview did not remove provisional lines automatically. 2) Hourly-accumulator is write-first (optimistic) and does not checkpoint replayer job markers, so replayed events look identical to new events. 3) No evidence of double-charging in finalized billing tables; final billing adjustment shows tokens consistent with deduped total. Action items so far: - Billing Eng deployed PR #482 to surface reconciler corrections to invoice preview (hotfix). - SRE throttled postback-replayer concurrency to 5 for backfills until we have a long-term fix. - Added an ingest-side soft rate limit to postback topic to smooth bursts. Metrics: peak ingest qps 275, normal steady state ~18 QPS for this org. Next steps: add idempotency token matching for replayed postbacks and add reconciler hook to mark provisional lines 'pending-reconcile' that UI hides from invoice preview.
resolution_notes: IN PROGRESS - temporary mitigations applied: 1) Hotfix merged (reconciler UI propagation) to ensure dedupe adjustments clear invoice preview within 5 minutes of reconciler run (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/pull/482). 2) Postback replayer concurrency limited and soft rate-limiter added to billing-ingest. 3) Finance flagged the provisional line for waiver if it reaches finalized invoice before reconciliation. Planned permanent fixes: idempotency for replayed postbacks, reconciler-to-accumulator contract change to prevent optimistic provisional writes, and enhanced monitoring/alerts for large backfill jobs. Customer update: Informed CleverDocs that no final charge will occur for the burst and to expect invoice preview correction within 30 minutes of reconciler completion. Follow-up items: track postback-replayer runs that target prod dedicated clusters and create a runbook for manual reconciliation in high-severity cases.
public_resolution_message: We identified a large replayed postback job that temporarily created a provisional hourly usage line before our deduplication process completed. We have applied mitigations (slowed replay, UI fix to surface reconciler corrections) and confirmed the customer's final billing will reflect the deduped usage. No payment will be taken for the provisional spike. We will follow up when the provisional line is fully cleared.
